---
name: Report a new result
about: Report a new square packing result of any kind (a packing, a bound, an exact value, a proof, or a correction) to be registered, checked and credited here
title: "<claim>: registration request"
---
<!--
What happens next is the result import process:
https://github.com/jlevy/squares/blob/main/packing/campaign/result-import.md
The source is retained at a pinned revision, the claim is registered as reported,
the certificate is replayed and the argument reviewed here, and you are answered on
this issue. The sections below are what makes that quick. A result of any kind is
welcome: a better packing, a lower bound, an exact value, a proof, a verification, or a
correction. Fill in what applies and leave the rest.
-->

**Credit name.** The name you want the result credited to on the site and in the record,
and any affiliation or link to go with it.
We encourage real names, which keep the record clear about who did what; a handle is
fine if you prefer one.

**Claim.** The packing, bound, value or other result, and what the record holds now at
those counts.

**Certificate.** What it is, where it is, and the revision of the source to pin (a full
commit id, or a DOI).

**Checking.** Each checker that accepted it: its arithmetic, the counts it reports, the
command that reruns it, and what it cost.

**What the checkers share.** An author, a point test, a symmetry reduction, code.

**Not done.** What has not been checked or formalized.

**Lineage and credit.** The work this builds on, and how the result should be credited.

**AI assistance.** Whether AI assisted the work, in your own words.
